question: Can the unchanged one-copy QWZ source hide the missing bounded-energy channels, and can chiral fixed-point stability and Coxeter covariance select common physical kinetics?
kills: The unchanged fixed-width mass-1 r=1 one-copy QWZ source hides seven extra independent gapless complex channels in its bulk at the original N/(2*pi) time scaling.
A point-defect dimension threshold h=1 proves all chiral quartics irrelevant for the extended 1+1D physical edge before common Lorentz geometry has been established.
The E8 equal-time algebra, vacuum, positive local quadratic-current energy and actual Coxeter covariance alone force a single physical velocity.
A stress-preserving conformal sector extension of the c=1 CAR edge can itself raise the central charge to c=8.
resolved: Uniform unscaled bulk gap at least one for the original fixed-width mass-1 strip
Full fixed-energy vacuum-Fock exhaustion by both edge branches, onto cutoff maps away from thresholds
Exact positive Coxeter-invariant unequal-velocity counterfamily on the intended E8 state space
Conditional common velocity selection by both physical C and J in the quadratic-current class
open: Raw essentialized P1 boundary kernel to canonical Yukawa contraction with injectivity and surjectivity
Raw seam winding to the typed primitive determinant-carrier interface
Local, state-, grading- and time-compatible realization of eight propagating CAR channels from P1/P2
Physical source implementation of both C and J commuting with one common time
Full local scaling-algebra exhaustion; more general interacting sources
3+1D bulk and quantum gravity; complete TFPT solution and all T1-T8
